outline:
1. To familiarize students with fuzzy logic and fuzzy inference.
2. To familiarize students with designing controllers based on fuzzy inference.
3. To familiarize students with system modeling through fuzzy rules.
schedule:
1.	Basic concepts of fuzzy logic
2.	Fuzzy Sets and fuzzy relations
3.	Fuzzy if-then rules
4.	Basics of fuzzy control
5.	Theoretical analyses of fuzzy controllers
6.	Fuzzy PID controller
7.	Fuzzy identification and estimation
8.	Adaptive fuzzy control
assessment: 2 Test: 25% each, Note: 5%, Homework: 15%, Final Report and Presentation: 30%.
